quote.text: When another blames you or hates you, or people voice similar criticisms, go to their souls, penetrate inside and see what sort of people they are. You will realize that there is no need to be racked with anxiety that they should hold any particular opinion about you.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that when someone criticizes you as a parent, their words often reflect their own struggles or limitations, not your worth or abilities.
    • By seeing criticism as a mirror into others’ hearts, you can stay calm and model emotional resilience and self-reflection for your children.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that an opponent's harsh words are more about their inner turmoil than a true assessment of your leadership; use this insight to maintain confidence.
    • This perspective allows you to address feedback constructively without losing focus or energy on unwarranted personal criticisms.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, feedback—even when it seems overly critical—can be traced back to differing needs and perspectives, offering insights for improvement.
    • By delving into the source of the critique, you can refine your product strategy and remain emotionally detached, focusing on value creation over personal validation.
